caption: The drawing depicts a blue glass goblet with a wide, round bowl and a sturdy, flared foot. The goblet is decorated with several oval and circular cutout or inset designs in white, which are symmetrically arranged around the body. On the front, there is a central oval medallion outlined in white that contains a small, detailed painting of a multicolored floral motif, featuring green leaves, red and yellow flowers, and a blue accent. The glass is rendered in varying shades of blue to convey depth and transparency, with white highlights suggesting reflections on the smooth glass surface. The composition is centered on the paper, with a thin double-line border framing the drawing. The background is plain and beige, and the artist's signature along with the date "1936" is written at the bottom.
title: Glass
